scope.summary: Partial visual roster timetable and safe slot-creation vertical slice, with limitations recorded.
implemented: Venue-local time-scaled assigned/open-shift timetable with DST and overnight calculations.
Accessible empty-slot links that prefill the existing scoped shift editor, plus a one-day schedule view.
Focused timeline tests, a manager walkthrough test source, and updated user guidance.
Restored three coordination policy/support files from the development branch so the stale roster PR branch has the CI-required script and dependencies.
Moved derived schedule-shift filtering after the schedule-day declaration to address the roster SSR initialization ordering defect.

criteria.description: Weekly schedule clearly shows staff assignments and time-based shift blocks; visually understandable without reading extensive instructions.

evidence.outcome: Time-scaled draft/published shift blocks implemented; route not browser-verified.

criteria.description: A manager can create a draft shift by interacting with an empty schedule area, with selected staff/date/time pre-populated and a reliable keyboard/touch alternative.

evidence.outcome: Slot URL carries date/time/employee values to prefill the existing form.
Walkthrough source exists; Playwright runner stopped before the test began.

criteria.description: Manager can reassign/move and edit a draft shift using direct visual controls, with preview, validation, clear error state and no silent mutation of published work.

evidence.outcome: Existing draft edit and preview/confirm move flows preserved; direct resizing was not added.

criteria.description: Clear, prominent draft/review/publish status and primary next action; existing safety/permission gates preserved.

evidence.outcome: Draft/published labels implemented; server-side permission paths were not browser-tested.

criteria.description: Desktop, tablet and phone usage works, with tested keyboard and touch equivalents; accessible labels and focus handling.

evidence.outcome: One-day view and keyboard-focusable slot links implemented; browser viewport and touch behavior remain unverified.

criteria.description: Existing roster-related regression tests pass, plus new targeted interaction tests for add/move/edit, timezones/DST, overlaps, permissions, stale edits, overnight shifts, and large schedules.

evidence.outcome: 29 focused roster unit/policy tests passed; the broader authenticated interaction/security matrix did not run.

criteria.description: Include at least one documented *first-time manager* acceptance walkthrough: create shift, assign person, correct time, publish; record steps/screenshots or verifiable Playwright evidence and any unresolved usability limitations.

evidence.outcome: Walkthrough and limitations documented; no successful browser run or screenshot exists.
Test source exists but execution was blocked before test start.

criteria.description: No production deployment or database changes without separate authorisation; PR targets `copilot/Development`, passing required Verify/Database checks and code review.

evidence.outcome: Latest Verify run validated issue/evidence markers, then failed because partial delivery retained the Fixes #241 auto-close keyword; database job and review were not complete at this record.

decisions: Keep the scope partial and leave Issue #241 open.
Reuse existing scoped server actions and permission gates; do not make database or production changes.
Follow-up fixes are part of this existing PR; issue #246 tracks cross-PR CI reliability. Exact full-suite validation is still outstanding.
limitations: No direct time resizing; slot shortcuts are coarse 00:00, 06:00, 12:00 and 18:00 presets.
Tablet, touch, accessible focus and large-roster runtime behavior remain unverified.
The authored manager walkthrough has not completed in a browser.
blockers: Supabase CLI 2.122.0 was unavailable to the isolated local browser runner.
The production build could not fetch the existing Google Fonts.
The PR body still contains the auto-close keyword Fixes #241; available GitHub MCP tools provide no PR-body editing operation.
Verify rejects the retained auto-close keyword for partial delivery, Database is pending, and code review remains outstanding.
Follow-up CI verification of coordination and SSR repairs is required before accepting this PR.
